meta.name: update-nanoclaw
meta.description: Efficiently bring upstream NanoClaw updates into a customized install, with preview, selective cherry-pick, and low token usage.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 预览上游更新,挑选合入定制安装
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果维护着定制版NanoClaw,想便捷同步官方更新
copy.tagline_en: Preview upstream updates and cherry-pick them into your customized install
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain a customized NanoClaw and want to sync official updates

howto.what: 让 Claude 把 NanoClaw 的官方更新合并进你本地版本,保留你的自定义改动。它先检查仓库状态、建备份,展示上游改动,让你选全量合并或挑部分提交,再解决冲突、运行构建与测试,最后查破坏性变更。只打开有冲突的文件。
howto.when: 当你在 Claude Code 中运行 `/update-nanoclaw` 时触发。通常在你希望把上游 NanoClaw 更新合并到本地定制版时使用。

say.text: 帮我预览一下上游 NanoClaw 有哪些更新
say.note: 它会显示改动列表和文件分类,不动代码。

say.text: 把上游的最新提交合并进来,保留我的本地修改
say.note: 它会先备份再合并,有冲突时逐个解决。

say.text: 只挑选几个提交来更新,不要全量合并
say.note: 它会让你选择提交哈希,然后逐个应用。

howto.what_en: Claude merges upstream NanoClaw updates into your customized install, keeping your local edits. It backs up, previews changes, merges or cherry-picks, resolves conflicts, runs build/tests, and checks for breaking changes. Only conflicted files are touched.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you run /update-nanoclaw in Claude Code, typically when you want to pull upstream NanoClaw changes into a customized install.

say_en.note: Shows the change list and categories, no edits made.

say_en.text: Merge latest upstream commits, keep my local changes.
say_en.note: Backs up first, then merges and resolves conflicts.

say_en.text: Cherry-pick a few commits instead of a full merge.
say_en.note: You pick commit hashes, then it applies each one.
